A major preventive attack would presumably have great potential to escalate to a wider conflict
, however, while a very limited one would be unlikely to have more than a marginal effect on its target.

AI-enhanced military capabilities could make regional aggression against a neighbor or other enemy appear feasible where it previously did not, leading to conflicts that could have considerable escalation potential depending on the target and the circumstances
. This possibility is arguably the most salient of these four scenario categories for the United States.
In the U.S.-China dyad, Chinese aggression against Taiwan would be the leading concern
. Advanced AI, or capabilities enabled by it, could also contribute to regional conflicts occurring elsewhere with costly implications for the United States.
